APARTAMENT 2+1 PER SHITJE NE ASTIR
Astiri njihet si nje zone urbane dinamike, me zhvillim te shpejte rezidencial dhe komercial.
Ne kete zone ofrojme per shitje apartament te tipologjise 2+1.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje objekt te mirembajtur me ashensor te vitit 2016.
Siperfaqe totale 84 m2
Siperfaqe neto 76 m2
Organizohet ne:
korridor hyres
sallon ndenje dhe ambjent gatimi
dy dhoma gjumi
nje tualet
ballkon.
Orientimi i favorshem Jug-Perendim ben te mundur qe apartamenti te kete drite natyrale gjate gjithe dites.
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Cmimi 13.000.000 leke
Per me teper detaje ose nje vizite ne prone, kontaktoni.
description_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN ASTIR Astiri is known as a dynamic urban area, with rapid residential and commercial development. In this area, we offer for sale a 2+1 apartment. The apartment is located in a well-maintained building with an elevator from 2016. Total area 84 m2 Net area 76 m2 Organized in: entrance hall, living room and kitchen area, two bedrooms, one bathroom, balcony. The favorable South-West orientation makes it possible for the apartment to have natural light throughout the day. The property has regular mortgage documentation. Price 13,000,000 lek. For more details or a visit to the property, contact us.
